TI specifies the TMDS181RGZR as the commercial-temperature version with a 0°C to +85°C operating range. The industrial-temperature variant is TMDS181IRGZR, rated from −40°C to +85°C.

The TMDS181 receives the high-speed HDMI/DVI TMDS signals, performs receiver equalization and clock-data recovery, and retransmits a cleaned-up signal. This helps compensate for random jitter, channel loss, and signal degradation caused by long PCB traces, cables, or other interconnects.

blocks.text: The Current Sensor 5A AC – 1 Phase is a versatile and essential device used to monitor and measure the current flowing through a single-phase alternating current (AC) circuit. It is specifically designed to measure current up to 5 amps, making it ideal for low-power applications such as household appliances, small machinery, and energy monitoring systems.

One of the main features of this sensor is its ability to measure AC current, which fluctuates in both direction and magnitude over time. This is particularly important for applications where power consumption varies, such as in lighting systems, small motors, and residential power networks. The sensor provides real-time current readings, enabling users to monitor their energy usage or prevent overloads.

The single-phase design makes it suitable for standard residential and small commercial environments, where power is typically supplied in a single-phase system. This type of system is common in areas where electricity demand is not extremely high, unlike industrial sectors that rely on three-phase power for larger equipment.

The sensor’s output is often analog, typically in the form of voltage (such as 0-5V) or current (like 4-20mA), which corresponds directly to the measured current. This allows easy integration with microcontrollers, energy meters, and other monitoring systems. Some models may also provide digital outputs (e.g., I2C or SPI), offering even more flexibility for data acquisition and control systems.

These sensors are commonly used in energy monitoring systems, overcurrent protection, industrial machinery, and renewable energy applications like solar panels. By helping track current levels, they ensure devices operate within safe limits, thus preventing damage due to overcurrent conditions. They are also useful in home automation systems for managing energy efficiency.

In summary, the Current Sensor 5A AC – 1 Phase is a reliable, accurate, and cost-effective tool for monitoring current in single-phase AC circuits, ensuring better energy management and equipment protection.
Non-Contact Measurement: Many models offer a clamp-on design, allowing the current to be measured without physically contacting the conductor, enhancing safety and ease of use.
Real-Time Monitoring: Provides live, real-time readings of the current, allowing for immediate detection of anomalies such as overloads or undercurrents in the circuit.
Overcurrent Protection: Some sensors come with built-in protection to prevent damage to the sensor or the connected system in case the measured current exceeds the safe limit.
Simple Integration: Easily integrates with microcontrollers (like Arduino or Raspberry Pi) and other monitoring systems, enabling quick setup and automation for energy monitoring and control.

Galvanic Isolation (Hall Effect): Many models use Hall effect technology, offering electrical isolation between the sensor and the high-voltage side, reducing the risk of electrical shock or short circuits.
Compact and Space-Efficient: Typically small in size, making it easy to install in tight spaces such as electrical panels or control cabinets.

Wide Application Range: Can be used in various applications including energy meters, power supply monitoring, industrial equipment protection, and renewable energy systems like solar panel monitoring.
Accurate Current Measurement: Delivers precise measurements of AC current, ensuring accurate power consumption readings, energy efficiency tracking, and system performance analysis.
Cost-Effective: Provides an affordable solution for current monitoring, ideal for both DIY projects and industrial applications without breaking the budget.
User-Friendly Output: Outputs a signal (typically analog or digital) that is easy to interpret, making it simple for users to incorporate into data logging, monitoring, or control systems.
Durable and Long-Lasting: Designed to withstand harsh environments and ensure long-term reliability, especially in industrial and high-use applications.
Versatile Output Options: Some models offer both analog and digital outputs, providing flexibility depending on the user’s needs and system requirements.

Connect to Your Computer: Plug the USB connector of the module into an available USB port on your computer. The necessary drivers for the CH340 chip should automatically install on most operating systems. If not, you may need to download and install them manually.

Screw Terminal Block: Connect the RS422 A+, B-, Y+, and Z- signals from your device to the corresponding terminals on the module’s screw terminal block. Ensure correct wiring according to the RS422 standard.
RJ45 Connector: Connect a standard Ethernet cable (CAT5 or higher) from the RJ45 port of the module to the RJ45 port of your RS422 device, ensuring the pinout is compatible.

Select UART Output (Optional Debugging): If you need to access the raw UART signals for debugging, use the jumper on the debugging header to select the output to the header instead of the RS422 transceiver.

Configure Your Software: In your communication software or application, select the virtual COM port assigned to the USB-to-Serial adapter and configure the appropriate baud rate, data bits, parity, and stop bits to match the settings of your RS422 device.
Begin Communication: You can now begin sending and receiving data between your computer and the RS422 device. Monitor the TX and RX LEDs on the module to observe data transmission.

The SYN470R is a single chip ASK/OOK (ON-OFF Keyed) RF receiver IC. This device is a true “antenna-in to data-out” monolithic device. All RF and IF tuning are accomplished automatically within the IC which eliminates manual tuning and reduces production costs. The result is a highly reliable yet low cost solution.

All IF filtering and post-detection (demodulator) data filtering is provided within the SYN470R, so no external filters are necessary. One of four demodulator filter bandwidths may be selected externally by the user.

The SYN470R offer two modes of operation; fixed-mode (FIX) and sweep-mode (SWP). In fixed mode the SYN470R functions as a conventional super-heterodyne receiver. In sweep mode the SYN470R sweeps a wider RF spectrum. Fixed-mode provides better selectivity and sensitivity performance and sweep mode enables the SYN470R to be used with low cost, imprecise transmitters.

IO Port/pins: ATtiny85 has a single bidirectional IO port – port B with 6 pins PB0 to PB5. All 6 pins can work as either input or output.
ADC: ATtiny85 has a 10-bit analog-to-digital converter with a multiplexer. It has four analog input channels where different analog sensors can be connected.
PWM: ATtiny85 has two 8-bit timers that can be used to generate PWM output. It has an 8-bit PWM with 4 output channels.

Timers: ATtiny85 has two 8-bit timers. They can work as a timer or a counter. A timer is used to generate time delay using a crystal clock / internal clock. The counter is used to count external events on external pins.

SPI: ATtiny85 has fully functioned 4 wire SPI with MOSI, MISO, SCK, and RESET pins. It is used to communicate with other uC, uP, sensor, or any peripheral device. Mostly it is used to program internal FLASH using an ICSP programmer.

IIC/I2C: It is also known as a two-wire interface because it needs only two wires 1) serial data – SDA and 2) serial clock – SCL. ATtiny85 has dedicated I2C pins to communicate with other I2C devices like I2C memory, I2C sensor, I2C, I2C clock, etc.
Memory: ATtiny85 has the following memory:
FLASH – its program memory. It is where the program is stored. ATtiny has 8 KB of FLASH to store the program.
EEPROM – its data memory. ATtiny85 has hardware architecture, so it has separate 512 bytes of EEPROM to store the data.
SRAM – Attiny85 has 512 bytes of SRAM that can be used during program execution and temporary data storage. There are 32 GPR (general purpose registers) that can be used for this purpose.

This breakout board will solve all your power-monitoring problems. Instead of struggling with two multimeters, you can just use the handy INA219B chip on this breakout to both measure both the high side voltage and DC current draw over I2C with 1% precision.

Most current-measuring devices such as our current panel meter are only good for low side measuring. That means that unless you want to get a battery involved, you have to stick the measurement resistor between the target ground and true ground. This can cause problems with circuits since electronics tend to not like it when the ground references change and move with varying current draw. This chip is much smarter – it can handle high side current measuring, up to +26VDC, even though it is powered with 3 or 5V. It will also report back that high side voltage, which is great for tracking battery life or solar panels.

A precision amplifier measures the voltage across the 0.1ohm, 1% sense resistor. Since the amplifier maximum input difference is +/-320mV this means it can measure up to +/-3.2 Amps. With the internal 12 bit ADC, the resolution at +/-3.2A range is 0.8mA. With the internal gain set at the minimum of div8, the max current is +/-400mA and the resolution is 0.1mA. Advanced hackers can remove the 0.1ohm current sense resistor and replace it with their own to change the range (say a 0.01ohm to measure up 32Amps with a resolution of 8mA).
Application I2C port zero drift / bidirectional current / power monitoring sensor module

The built-in red voltmeter display shows the input and output voltage.

There are 2 buttons which control the display. The button on the left (near the Vin- terminal) turns the display on or off. The button on the right switches the display between displaying the input voltage and displaying the output voltage. There are two red LEDs marked ‘IN‘ and ‘OUT‘ that indicate which voltage is currently being displayed.
The display has a stated accuracy of ± 0.1V. Some versions of the module have a calibration sequence that can be performed to calibrate the display against a reference voltmeter if desired.
To calibrate the display, perform the following steps
select the voltage reading (input or output) that you want to calibrate so that it is shown on the display.

Hold the right button down for approximately 2 seconds. When you release it, the display should be blinking which indicates that it is in the calibration mode. If the display is not blinking, then it is a version of the module that does not support the calibration process.

Use the left button to decrement the reading down and the right button to increment it up. Each press of the button adjusts the calibration by less than 0.1V, so you may need to press the button several times to see a change in the reading.
Once you are happy with the reading, press the right button again for approximately 2 seconds to save the setting.
The module has a multi-turn potentiometer for adjustment of the output voltage.
Turning the pot CW increases the output voltage while turning it CCW decreases the output voltage.

The lowest output voltage is approximately 1.25V. The upper limit of the adjustment range will depend on the input voltage and is typically about 1.5V less than the input voltage. With a 12V input for instance, the upper output limit will be approximately 10.5V.

Sooner or later, the Arduino starts to feel a little claustrophobic. Your sketches start running out of memory, so you need more RAM. You want to talk serial to another peripheral (like an RFID Module) AND watch the action in the Serial Monitor at the same time, so you need more UARTS. You want to use SPI and control a motor and read a few sensors, and pretty soon you’re out of pins, so you need more I/O pins. You’re logging data, and running out of 1k EEPROM fast, so a bit more EEPROM would sure be handy.
The obvious solution to this problem is an Arduino Mega 2560. Oh yeah, this thing is powerful! 54 pins! 4 UARTS! 8k RAM! You add it to your cart, and then realize it’s almost 200LE.

Now maybe you’re wondering, isn’t there anything in-between that might be a bit less cash? Indeed there is, it’s called the ATmega1284P and today I’m going to explore getting Arduino to run on it, on a breadboard.

Here’s a quick breakdown of three chips… The 328P powers the Uno, the 2560P powers the Mega 2560, and the 1284P is the ‘Goldilocks’ chip, nestled right in the middle–EXCEPT for RAM. It has an abundance of RAM (16k!) which is important because RAM is typically the resource you run out of the quickest.

I’m going to build an Arduino ATmega1284P circuit on a breadboard, burn a bootloader, and upload sketches to it, all using the Arduino 1.0 IDE. This will all go better if you have done it once first with a regular ATmega328P. Doing these things on that chip is well-documented, and easy to get support on the forums if something goes wrong.
So first, read up and practice up on a 328P with help from these handy pages on the Arduino Wiki:
There are three sections to the circuit show above. (Click on the image for a higher-resolution).
Power/Timing. I’m using a 16MHz crystal and 22pF caps for timing and a 0.1uF cap for power.
FTDI. I use a UGE Electronics CH340 breakout to program everything, so I’ve set this breadboard up with a connector for that mechanism.
Arduino ISP. To burn the boot loader using Arduino as ISP, six connections are needed from the Arduino. The from/to pins are indicated on the schematic.
For another view, check out this forum thread: Using the 1284p/664p (IDE, bread board and boot loaders)
The Arduino makes it easy to support a new ‘Hardware Platform’. The files you need are hosted on github, the Mighty 1284P Platform for Arduino.
WARNING this ONLY WORKS on Arduino 1.0. It would be possible to back-port to 0022, but seems unneeded now that 1.0 is nearing final release.
2. Unzip it a folder called ‘hardware’ off your sketches directory, e.g. /Users/maniacbug/Source/Arduino/hardware/mighty-1284p

Once you have the Mighty 1284P platform set up, burning a bootloader is trivial. Follow the Arduino ISP instructions. You first burn the “Arduino ISP” sketch onto a regular Ardunio. Then change the “Boards” setting to the Mighty 1284P, hook up the ‘Arduino’ connections in the schematic above, choose “Tools > Programmer > Arduino as ISP” from the IDE, and then “Tools > Burn bootloader.”
To verify that it worked, move the LED to pin 1, and power cycle the breadboard. When the bootloader starts it flashes pin 1.

Uploading a sketch is trivial now that the platform is set up and bootloader is in place. Try the ‘Blink’ example first, but change the LED pin to ‘1’ in the sketch. (Of course, move the LED back to the right pin, which is pin 2 on the MCU).

When you refer to a “pin” in the Arduino environment, e.g. “digitalWrite(13,HIGH)”, the system maps that pin onto a MCU pin. There is definitely no standard pin mapping for 1284P, many people have published their own. I chose a mapping that makes sense for the breadboard, where the digital pins start at MCU pin 1, and simply go around the chip counter-clockwise.

Designed for multiple earthing systems, this innovative tool allows you to quickly and safely measure earth resistance from 0.05 to 1500Ω simply by clamping around the earth conductor. Its True RMS capability ensures accurate AC current readings, even with distorted waveforms, making it an essential instrument for electrical safety inspections and maintenance.
Benefit: Measure earth resistance in multiple earthing systems quickly and easily without the hassle of driving auxiliary earth spikes into the ground, saving time and effort.

Benefit: Allows you to save and recall up to 100 measurement data points, streamlining data collection and analysis in the field.

How Earth Resistance Measurement Works (Multiple Earthing System)

In a multiple earthing system, the earth resistances of various grounding points (R1, R2…Rn) are effectively connected in parallel. The combined resistance (Rs) of these parallel paths is significantly smaller than the individual earth resistance being measured (Rx). The Kyoritsu 4200 injects a constant voltage (V) into the grounding system via the current injection transformer (CT1) and measures the resulting current (I) using the detection transformer (CT2). By applying Ohm’s law (Rx = V/I), the instrument calculates and displays the earth resistance of the clamped conductor.

blocks.text: The AT89S52-24PU is a high-performance, low-power CMOS 8-bit microcontroller from Atmel, built around an 80C51 core. It is fully compatible with the industry-standard MCS-51 instruction set and pinout, making it a versatile and easy-to-upgrade solution for existing designs. This microcontroller is manufactured using Atmel’s high-density nonvolatile memory technology, integrating a powerful 8-bit CPU with programmable Flash memory on a single monolithic chip. This integration provides a highly-flexible and cost-effective foundation for a wide range of embedded control applications.

At the heart of the device is 8KB of In-System Programmable (ISP) Flash memory, which allows the program memory to be reprogrammed in-circuit or by a conventional programmer, offering immense flexibility during development and production. The chip also contains 256 bytes of internal RAM for data storage and operation. It supports a fully static operation mode from 0 Hz up to 24 MHz, enabling designs to optimize for power consumption by scaling the clock speed down to a complete halt without losing data.

The microcontroller is equipped with a rich set of integrated peripherals, including 32 programmable I/O lines, three 16-bit timer/counters, a full-duplex UART serial channel, and a watchdog timer. It also supports advanced power management through two software-selectable power-saving modes: Idle Mode, where the CPU is halted while peripherals remain active, and Power-down Mode, which freezes the oscillator to minimize energy consumption until the next interrupt or reset, making it suitable for battery-powered applications.

blocks.text: The YGW60N65F1 is a trench field-stop IGBT engineered for medium-power, high-frequency power conversion. Rated for a collector-emitter breakdown of 650 V and continuous current capability suitable for heavy duty applications, it comes in a TO-247 package that eases thermal management and mounting. The device is intended for designers who need a robust discrete IGBT that balances blocking voltage with high current capability while remaining compact.

Built using Trench-Stop technology, the YGW60N65F1 emphasizes low conduction losses (low VCE(sat)) and stable switching behavior across temperature. It exhibits a positive temperature coefficient in saturation voltage, simplifying safe paralleling of devices. The part also provides enhanced avalanche capability and specified dynamic parameters (gate charge, capacitances, switching energies) so engineers can accurately budget drive losses and thermal performance in real systems.

Switching characteristics are optimized for inductive loads and mid-to-high frequency converters: the device shows short turn-on/turn-off delays and defined switching energies, while its integrated body diode delivers fast, soft recovery for commutation tolerance. Rated for wide junction temperatures (up to 175 °C), the YGW60N65F1 is suited to UPS, inverter, welding converter and PFC designs where reliability and thermal robustness are required.

makers-488566.summary: The D8741AD is a 40-pin, 8-bit slave microcomputer with 1KB UV-EPROM, designed to offload I/O and control tasks from a master CPU in various system configurations.

blocks.text: The D8741AD is a programmable peripheral interface controller, designed as a complete, self-sufficient 8-bit single-chip microcomputer. It features its own CPU, UV-EPROM program memory, and RAM, allowing it to operate as an intelligent slave device. Its primary role is to offload input/output (I/O) handling and peripheral control tasks from a master CPU, thereby increasing the overall efficiency of a microprocessor-based system.

This IC is engineered for seamless integration into master/slave configurations with various 8-bit and 16-bit microprocessors like the 8048, 8085A, and 8086. It communicates with the host processor through an asynchronous interface that includes a bidirectional data bus, status registers, and control lines (RD, WR). This structure allows for flexible data exchange via interrupt, DMA, or polled operation methods.

At its core, the D8741AD contains 1K bytes of user-programmable UV-EPROM and 64 bytes of RAM. It is equipped with 18 I/O lines organized into two ports, an 8-bit timer/counter, and a clock circuit. The use of UV-EPROM for program memory provides significant design flexibility, allowing for program development and revisions before finalization.

makers-487631.summary: The BDW94C is a -12A, -100V PNP Darlington power transistor in a TO-220 package. It is the complementary pair to the BDW93C.

blocks.text: The BDW94C is a robust silicon power transistor engineered using an Epitaxial-Base PNP process and configured in a monolithic Darlington arrangement. This design integrates two transistors into a single device, resulting in a component capable of delivering very high current gain. It is specifically intended for demanding roles in both power linear amplification and high-speed switching circuits, making it a versatile solution for controlling significant power levels in industrial environments.

The transistor is constructed in a monolithic Darlington configuration, which internally pairs two bipolar transistors to multiply the current gain, allowing a small base current to control a much larger collector current. This entire assembly is securely housed in a industry-standard Jedec TO-220 plastic package. This package is renowned for its mechanical durability and excellent thermal performance, facilitating easy mounting to a heat sink to manage the substantial power dissipation during operation.

A key feature of its design is the integration of an antiparallel collector-emitter diode within the same monolithic structure. This internal diode provides inherent protection against voltage spikes in inductive load applications. Furthermore, the BDW94C is offered as the direct PNP complement to the BDW93C NPN transistor, which simplifies the design of push-pull output stages and other symmetrical circuits.

It is engineered to provide a reliable and space-efficient solution for circuits requiring multiple identical or related resistance values. This specific model is part of a low-profile series, designed to facilitate high-density packaging on printed circuit boards (PCBs), thereby saving valuable board space and simplifying the assembly process compared to using discrete resistors.

This particular 8-pin component features an “Isolated” circuit type (designated by the letter ‘B’ in its part number). This means that each of the resistors within the network is independent and not internally connected to the others. This configuration offers maximum design flexibility, allowing each resistor to be used in separate parts of a circuit without any shared common connection points, functioning as if they were individual, discrete resistors in a single package.

Constructed with high-reliability materials, including RU02 paste, the network ensures stable performance. The device is clearly marked with a code such as “B331G” on its body. makers-486003.summary: The 14D221K is a 220V metal oxide varistor that provides robust overvoltage protection by clamping transient surges and absorbing high energy pulses up to 4500A

blocks.text: The 14D221K is a protective electronic component designed to safeguard circuits from voltage transients. Its operation is defined by its highly non-linear electrical characteristic. Under normal operating conditions, where the voltage remains below its threshold, it exhibits a very high electrical resistance, making it virtually invisible to the circuit. However, when a sudden voltage spike occurs, its resistance drops dramatically within nanoseconds.

This device is constructed from a ceramic mass of zinc oxide (ZnO) grains mixed with other metal oxides, forming the core varistor element. The boundaries between these zinc oxide grains are responsible for the component’s ability to clamp over-voltages. This sintered ceramic disk is then packaged within a flame-retardant epoxy resin coating, which provides both mechanical robustness and electrical insulation, making it suitable for demanding environments.

The primary purpose of the 14D221K is to divert the dangerous surge current away from sensitive components, thereby limiting the voltage across the circuit to a safe, predetermined level known as the clamping voltage. By providing a low-impedance path to ground during an over-voltage event, it absorbs the transient energy and dissipates it as heat, effectively sacrificing itself to protect the rest of the system.

Low clamping ratio for effective voltage limitation.
No follow-on current after the surge subsides.

Current flowing through its element raises the body temperature; heat spreads through the cement and is dissipated to the surrounding air. Under steady load the warming is gradual and predictable not dramatic and the part radiates thermal energy steadily rather than in spikes. blocks.text: The SEMIKRON SKKT 105/16E is part of the SKKT 105 series of dual thyristor modules housed in the industry-standard SEMIPACK 1 package. Each module integrates two silicon-controlled rectifiers (SCRs) on a common isolated metal baseplate, using aluminium-oxide (Al₂O₃) ceramic insulation to achieve high thermal conductivity and electrical isolation. Hard-soldered joints between the semiconductor chips and substrates ensure excellent mechanical robustness and long-term reliability under thermal cycling.

Rated for a repetitive peak reverse (V<sub>RRM</sub>) and forward blocking voltage (V<sub>DRM</sub>) of 1 600 V, the SKKT 105/16E supports an average on-state current (I<sub>TAV</sub>) of 115 A at a case temperature of 80 °C. Internally, the two thyristors share a common anode–cathode connection but have separate gate and cathode terminals for independent control. The top-mounted power terminals (marked 1–3) facilitate low-inductance connections, while the gate pins (K1, G1, K2, G2) allow isolated triggering.

The module’s package is UL-recognized (file E 63 532) and designed for screw-mounting to heatsinks; typical mounting torque values are 5 Nm to the heatsink and 3 Nm to the terminals. Operating junction temperatures range from 40 °C up to 130 °C, making it suitable for rigorous industrial environments.

Multi-capture functions such as MAX/MIN, peak-hold and data-hold allow technicians to freeze transient readings, while the auto power-off feature conserves battery life between intermittent checks.

Ergonomics are equally refined: angled probe ports facilitate swift connection changes, the fold-out stand props the meter upright for hands-free measurement, and the overall layout minimizes accidental dial rotations. Whether diagnosing electrical distribution panels, verifying control-system signals, or troubleshooting complex motor circuits, the UNI-T UT195DS combines intuitive design, field-hardened durability and advanced filtering capabilities to deliver confident readings in the toughest conditions.

makers-446722.summary: The DC 3.3-12V Soil Moisture Detector Module with corrosion-resistant probe monitors soil moisture, perfect for automated irrigation and plant care systems.

blocks.text: DC 3.3-12V Soil Moisture Detector Module Corrosion Resistance Probe

The DC 3.3–12V Soil Moisture Detector Module with a corrosion-resistant probe is an essential sensor for monitoring soil moisture levels in gardening, agriculture, and environmental sensing projects. Designed to be compact, affordable, and easy to integrate, this module helps users detect whether soil is dry, moist, or wet, enabling automation in watering systems and optimizing plant care.

Operating on a voltage range of 3.3V to 12V, the module is compatible with most development boards, such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP8266, and ESP32, making it a popular choice for DIY electronics enthusiasts and professionals alike. The built-in corrosion-resistant probe ensures durability, allowing the module to function reliably even with extended exposure to wet soil.

The sensor works by measuring the electrical conductivity between two metal prongs on the probe. Moist soil conducts electricity better than dry soil, and this difference is converted into an analog signal that represents the moisture level. The module also features a digital output that can be triggered when the moisture level crosses a certain threshold, which can be adjusted using an onboard potentiometer.

With dual outputs (analog and digital), users can either measure precise moisture values or trigger events like activating a pump, buzzer, or sending notifications. The module is ideal for automated irrigation systems, plant monitoring, greenhouse automation, and educational projects related to smart farming.

Thanks to its simplicity and wide voltage compatibility, the DC 3.3–12V Soil Moisture Sensor is perfect for beginners and advanced users looking to build intelligent gardening systems. Its anti-corrosion design makes it more reliable than basic probes, ensuring consistent performance over time in outdoor or humid conditions.

The TLP521-1consists of a photo-transistor optically coupled to a gallium arsenide infrared emitter diode.
This device can be used for applications where galvanic isolation is necessary, like Switch Mode Power Supply, relay driver board, etc.
The TLP521 is an optocoupler that has a photo-transistor that is controlled based on light (photon).
And on the opposite side, it has an IR (infrared) LED.
When the IR LED is powered, the light from the LED is collected by the receiver of the transistor and it conducts.
This IC is used to provide electrical isolation between two circuits, one part of the circuit is connected to the IR LED and the other to Photo-transistor.
The digital signal given to the IR LED will be reflected on the transistor but there will be no electrical connection between the LED and the transistor.

This comes in very handy when you are trying to isolate a noisy signal from your digital electronics, so if you are looking for an IC to provide optical isolation in your circuit design, then this IC might be the right choice for you.

The UT12S-ROW includes a built-in flashlight to illuminate test points in dark areas. Its design emphasizes reliability and safety: the unit is insulated, has an auto shutoff function, and is intended for repeated use in typical service and maintenance tasks.

Electricians and maintenance personnel use it before performing work on circuits to confirm live status. microohm-110200.summary: 🧠 7406 TTL IC: hex inverter (6 NOT gates) 🚪 Open-collector outputs—ideal for driving higher loads ⚡ Standard 5V operation (TTL compatible) 🔌 Can interface LEDs, relays (with driver), and logic signals 🧩 Great for level interfacing and signal inversion 🛠️ Requires pull-up resistor for proper logic HIGH output 🚀 Fast switching for clean digital edges 📦 DIP package—easy breadboard prototyping

blocks.text: The 7406 (ex 74LS06) is a chip with six open-collector inverters that has a maximum output voltage of 30V and a sink current of 40 mA so that they can interface with high-level circuits (such as MOSFETs), or for driving high-current loads.

When you have an open collector output, it means it’s easy to connect it to other chips that use different logic levels. However, it also means you can’t just swap it out with a regular inverter chip.

The 74LS06 comes in a 14-pin package, and you need to connect it to power before you can use it. Most 7400 ICs support a VCC voltage of 5V. One difference between the HC and LS versions of the chip is that the 74HC06 supports 2V to 6V, while the 74LS06 only supports 5V.

blocks.text: BC327 is a general purpose PNP Transistor, the base of which needs to be connected to the ground, to turn on the transistor. This transistor is available in various versions and is manufactured by many different companies, that’s why, the gain of the transistor may vary depending upon the version of the transistor. So, it’s recommended to check out the datasheet of the device before proceeding with the application and the datasheet for this specific transistor can be found on the bottom of the page.

When the transistor is turned off, we can see a positive voltage on the transistor’s base, if we measure the voltage between the base and the emitter. Based on the characteristics of the transistor, a minimum amount of current needs to flow out of the base to turn the transistor on and that is when a positive voltage appears on the base, leakage current starts to flow from the base to the ground. The characteristic curve below shows that a minimum of -10mA current needs to flow through the base to flow -300mA of collector current.
The below diagram shows the correlation between base current and collector current.

blocks.v: Collector · Electrons Emitted from Emitter Collected by the Collector
Base · Controls the biasing of the transistor
Emitter · Electrons emitted from the emitter into the first PN junction

blocks.text: Suitable for AF-Driver Stages and Low-Power Output Stage
Note:Complete Technical Details can be found at the BC327 datasheet given at the end of this page.

The BC327 Transistor is a general-purpose PNP transistor, in which holes are the primary charge carrier of the device. When the base of the transistor is connected to the ground, leakage current starts to flow out of the base to the ground and the depletion region at the base of the transistor starts to shrink and more and more electrons start migrating from the collector to the emitter and into the circuit thus current flows constantly through the circuit.

Unlike MOSFETs, transistors are current-controlled devices, which means they can be turned on or off by supplying the required base current (for the BC327 transistor it’s -10mA). BC327 is a PNP transistor that means it will conduct when it’s connected to the ground and it will turn off when the base is connected to 5V.
The simulated circuit below shows how this transistor behaves when a base current is applied and when no current is provided to the base.

When we turn on the transistor by connecting the base to the ground the transistor will remain on unless the voltage at the base of the transistor reaches more than 1.2V. The base of the transistor cannot be left floating otherwise there could be false triggering to the transistor which may lead to issues in the circuit. To resolve this issue, we need to add pullup resistors, for example, in the above case, a 10K resistor is used to pull up the base of the transistor.

In the above example, we are using BC327 as a simple switching device and we have used a small 12V motor as a load. The small button here is for providing the trigger to the transistor and can be removed to leave simple contacts to touch. The 10KΩ resistor is for limiting the current to base and to avoid breaching maximum voltage allowed at the base and 2.1KΩ resistor is for limiting the current flowing out of base to ground.

The MPU-6050 is the latest product of InvenSense company products. This sensor is used in Ardupilot autopilot. The sensor contains a 3-axis MEMS accelerometer and a 3-axis MEMS gyro in a single chip. It is very accurate since it contains 16-bit analog to digital-conversion hardware for each channel. Therefore it captures the x, y, and z channels at the same time.
Also, it is accurate because you have the 3-axis gyro and 3-axis accelerometers on a single chip so you do not need to align them.

The sensor has a “Digital Motion Processor” (DMP), also called a “Digital Motion Processing Unit”. This DMP can be programmed with firmware made by Innisense and can do complex calculations with the sensor values.

blocks.text: The MPU6050 is a Micro-Electro-Mechanical System (MEMS) that consists of a 3-axis Accelerometer and 3-axis Gyroscope inside it. This helps us to measure acceleration, velocity, orientation, displacement, and many other motion-related parameters of a system or object. This module also has a (DMP) Digital Motion Processor inside it which is powerful enough to perform complex calculations and thus free up the work for Microcontroller.

The module also has two auxiliary pins which can be used to interface external IIC modules like a magnetometer, however, it is optional. Since the IIC address of the module is configurable more than one MPU6050 sensor can be interfaced to a Microcontroller using the AD0 pin. This module also has well-documented and revised libraries available hence it’s very easy to use with famous platforms like Arduino. So if you are looking for a sensor to control motion for your RC Car, Drone, Self-balancing Robot, Humanoid, Biped, or something like that then this sensor might be the right choice for you.

The hardware of the module is very simple, it comprises the MPU6050 as the main component as shown above. Since the module works on 3.3V, a voltage regulator is also used. The IIC lines are pulled high using a 4.7k resistor and the interrupt pin is pulled down using another 4.7k resistor.

The MPU6050 module allows us to read data from it through the IIC bus. Any change in motion will be reflected on the mechanical system which will in turn vary the voltage. Then the IC has a 16-bit ADC which it uses to accurately read these changes in voltage and stores it in the FIFO buffer and makes the INT (interrupt) pin to go high. This means that the data is ready to be read, so we use a MCU to read the data from this FIFO buffer through IIC communication. As easy as it might sound, you may face some problem while actually trying to make sense of the data. However there are lots of platforms like Arduino using which you can start using this module in no time by utilizing the readily available libraries explained below.

blocks.text: This is a joystick very similar to the ‘analog’ joysticks on PS2 (PlayStation 2) controllers. Directional movements are simply two potentiometers – one for each axis. Pots are ~10k each. This joystick also has a select button that is actuated when the joystick is pressed down. This is a Joystick module that has X,Y analog outputs and has a switch that detects button press. The joystick is made up of two passive potentio-meters (variable resistors) and a push button and therefore can be used at any standard voltage levels. Lots of robotic projects need a joystick. This module offers an affordable solution to that.

The Joystick module is similar to analog joysticks found in gamepads. It is made by mounting two potentiometers at a 90 degrees angle. The potentiometers are connected to a short stick centered by springs. This module produces an output of around 2.5V from X and Y when it is in resting position. Moving the joystick will cause the output to vary from 0v to 5V depending on its direction. If you connect this module to a microcontroller, you can expect to read a value of around 512 in its resting position (expect small variations due to tiny imprecisions of the springs and mechanism) When you move the joystick you should see the values change from 0 to 1023 depending on its position.
Joystick that can be interfaced with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and other Microcontrollers and Embedded Boards
Used for custom designed/experimental RC planes, RC Cars
It used for CNC Machines or other industrial controls
Electronic games pads similar to PlayStation.
Using the board to connect the joystick is reduced to the following pins:
VRx – the analog output for the vertical axis (in the middle position, the value is equal to half of the supply voltage VCC/2).
VRy– Analog output for the horizontal axis (in the middle position, the value is equal to half of the supply voltage VCC/2).
SW– Digital signal button, in case of activation, it reaches the value of the GND, deactivated – is in thefloating status – so you need to add a pulling-up resistor to power.

Because of the few-procent tolerance of the resistors, the middle value may not be equal to half the supply voltage (VCC/2). The manufacturer recommends measuring the voltage in the middle position and writing a permanent, rigid value in the program.

The joystick is a device of low power. It must be connected only to the inputs of high input impedance, for example, the ports of the microcontroller. Do not connect the device to the elements consuming a relatively large current: LEDs, motors – as this will damage the system.

تأتي الشاشة بتصميم قابل للطي، بحيث يمكن فتحها عند الحاجة وإغلاقها بعد الاستخدام. هذا التصميم يساعد على توفير المساحة داخل السيارة، كما يساعد في حماية سطح الشاشة من الخدوش والأتربة عند عدم الاستخدام. لذلك تعتبر اختيارًا مناسبًا لمن يريد شاشة كاميرا خلفية صغيرة لا تظل مرفوعة طوال الوقت.

بفضل جسمها الخفيف وزر التشغيل البسيط والتصميم القابل للطي، يمكن تركيبها في السيارات والمركبات الصغيرة وبعض تطبيقات الصيانة ومشروعات السيارات المعدلة. وهي مناسبة للعملاء الذين يحتاجون شاشة اقتصادية وبسيطة لعرض صورة الكاميرا بدون الحاجة إلى شاشة كبيرة أو نظام ترفيهي كامل.

blocks.text: QIANLI 008 Glue Remover Blade Flexible Tin Blade Set

QIANLI 008 Glue Remover Blade Flexible Tin Blade Set is a professional precision repair tool designed for safe glue removal, adhesive scraping, solder mask cleaning, and delicate motherboard maintenance. It is especially useful for mobile phone repair technicians working on CPU, IC, BGA chip areas, small electronic components, screen frames, adhesive residue, and sensitive board surfaces that require controlled scraping without aggressive damage.

The QIANLI 008 glue remover tool is designed for technicians who need a thin, flexible, and controllable blade for detailed repair work. During smartphone motherboard repair, glue residue around chips, BGA areas, CPU layers, IC modules, and small components can be difficult to remove using ordinary tools. A thick or rigid scraper may damage pads, scratch the board surface, or apply too much pressure. This tool helps make the process more controlled by using a flexible thin blade mounted into a pen-style metal handle.

The tool is suitable for removing adhesive from mobile phones, PCBs, IC chip edges, BGA chip surroundings, CPU glue, screen adhesive residue, and other repair surfaces where accuracy is important. The blade has a slim shape that can reach narrow areas, while the curved tip helps the technician work around components and edges with better access. It is a practical accessory for mobile service centers, motherboard repair workshops, screen repair benches, and electronics maintenance setups.

The handle is made from aluminum alloy according to the supplied images, giving the tool a lightweight but firm structure. The body has a non-slip center grip with fine grooves that improve hand control during detailed scraping. The front head uses a limit fixed head and a plated anti-oxidation copper head design according to the image data, allowing the blade to be installed securely and removed when replacement is needed. The structure is easy to disassemble and assemble, making blade replacement simple for daily workshop use.

The QIANLI 008 blade is described as a flexible tin blade for glue removal. Its thin and flexible profile makes it useful for working on delicate repair areas where a standard steel blade may be too aggressive. It can help remove glue residue, soften scraping around ICs, clean adhesive from small parts, and assist in motherboard BGA chip cleaning when used carefully by a trained technician.

Because this is a precision blade tool, the technician should use it with controlled hand pressure and proper repair technique. It should not be forced under components or used in a way that may cut tracks, pads, or nearby small parts. When used correctly, it can reduce the need for repeated scraping and help improve cleaning accuracy around chips and motherboard repair areas.

يعمل الموتور ضمن مدى تشغيل من 3 فولت إلى 12 فولت تيار مستمر، مما يمنحه مرونة جيدة للاستخدام مع دوائر ومصادر تغذية مختلفة منخفضة الجهد. أما السرعة المذكورة 150 دورة في الدقيقة فهي مناسبة للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى سرعة متوسطة مع عزم أفضل. كما أن وجود أسلاك ملحومة مسبقًا يسهل عملية التوصيل والتركيب داخل المشروع دون الحاجة إلى تجهيز إضافي.

يأتي الموتور بعمود خرج من نوع دي شافت، وهو شكل شائع يساعد على تثبيت العجلات أو الكوبلنات أو التروس أو الأجزاء الميكانيكية الأخرى بشكل أفضل. لذلك فهو مناسب لمشروعات العربات الذكية، والآليات المتحركة، وأنظمة القفل، والنماذج التجريبية، وتطبيقات التحكم في الحركة صغيرة الحجم.
إذا كنت تحتاج إلى موتور صغير وعملي يوفر توازنًا جيدًا بين الحجم والعزم وسهولة الاستخدام، فإن هذا الموديل يعتبر خيارًا مناسبًا للمشروعات التعليمية والعملية والتجريبية.

blocks.text: Breadboard 1660 Tie-Point Solderless Breadboard with 3 Binding Posts and Aluminum Base

The 1660 Tie-Point Solderless Breadboard with 3 Binding Posts and Aluminum Base is a practical and spacious prototyping platform for engineers, students, technicians, and electronics hobbyists who need a reliable board for temporary circuit construction without soldering.

This breadboard is built to support a wide range of development and test applications, especially when working with through-hole components, jumper wires, prototype modules, and educational electronics circuits. Because it is solderless, it allows users to quickly assemble, modify, and remove circuits without permanent connections, which makes it highly suitable for testing ideas before transferring them to a final PCB.

The board includes 2 double terminal strips with 1260 tie-points and 4 power distribution lanes with 400 tie-points, giving a total of 1660 tie-points. It also includes 3 binding posts, which provide convenient external power connection options for different prototyping needs. The clear row and column labeling helps simplify circuit tracing and improves workflow during assembly and debugging.

Constructed with an ABS plastic body, brass contact clips, and a strong black aluminum base plate, this breadboard offers both mechanical durability and repeated usability. The internal clips are designed to accept wires in the 20–29 AWG range, making it compatible with many commonly used solid-core jumper wires and standard component leads.

This solderless breadboard is especially useful for Arduino shield prototyping, embedded system testing, sensor experiments, power distribution setups, classroom demonstrations, and general-purpose electronics development. Its reusable design allows circuits to be built, adjusted, and dismantled many times, making it a valuable tool for both learning and professional work.

For best performance, it is recommended to use solid-core wires when building circuits on the board. The included adhesive-backed structure and mounting-ready layout also help users integrate the board into larger bench setups or project enclosures when needed.
Contact Clip Material: Brass / phosphor bronze plated spring clip
لوحة تجارب بدون لحام 1660 نقطة توصيل مع 3 أطراف توصيل وقاعدة ألومنيوم

تُعد لوحة التجارب بدون لحام 1660 نقطة توصيل مع 3 أطراف توصيل وقاعدة ألومنيوم منصة عملية ومناسبة لتجميع واختبار الدوائر الإلكترونية بشكل مؤقت دون الحاجة إلى لحام. وهي مناسبة للمهندسين، والطلاب، والفنيين، والهواة الذين يحتاجون إلى وسيلة مرنة وسريعة لتجربة الأفكار الإلكترونية قبل تنفيذها على لوحة دائرة مطبوعة نهائية.

تتميز هذه اللوحة بمساحة عمل كبيرة تساعد على تنفيذ دوائر أكثر تعقيدًا مقارنة باللوحات الصغيرة، لذلك فهي مناسبة لتجارب المكونات ذات الأرجل التقليدية، وأسلاك التوصيل، ووحدات التجارب، والمشروعات التعليمية والتطبيقية. وبما أنها تعمل بدون لحام، يمكن بناء الدائرة ثم تعديلها أو فكها بسهولة في أي وقت، وهو ما يجعلها مثالية لأعمال التطوير السريع والاختبار المتكرر.

تحتوي اللوحة على شريطين رئيسيين مزدوجين بإجمالي 1260 نقطة توصيل، بالإضافة إلى 4 مسارات لتوزيع الطاقة بإجمالي 400 نقطة توصيل، ليصبح إجمالي نقاط التوصيل 1660 نقطة. كما تضم 3 أطراف توصيل لتسهيل ربط مصادر التغذية أو نقاط الإشارة الخارجية. ويساعد وجود العلامات والإحداثيات على الصفوف والأعمدة في تنظيم التوصيلات وتتبعها أثناء التجربة والصيانة.

تم تصنيع اللوحة باستخدام هيكل من بلاستيك ABS مع مشابك تلامس معدنية وقاعدة ألومنيوم سوداء تمنحها ثباتًا أفضل ومتانة مناسبة للاستخدام المتكرر. كما أنها تدعم استخدام الأسلاك بمقاسات من 20 إلى 29 AWG، وهو ما يجعلها مناسبة لمعظم أسلاك التوصيل الصلبة والمكونات الإلكترونية الشائعة.

هذه اللوحة مناسبة جدًا لتجارب أردوينو، واختبار الحساسات، وتجميع دوائر الطاقة والإشارات، والتعليم العملي في المعامل، والمشروعات الإلكترونية المختلفة. كما أن طبيعتها القابلة لإعادة الاستخدام تجعلها أداة مهمة في ورش الإلكترونيات والتدريب والتطوير.
ولأفضل أداء أثناء الاستخدام، يُفضل استعمال أسلاك صلبة عند التوصيل على اللوحة. كما يساعد تصميمها العملي في تثبيتها ضمن بيئات العمل المختلفة أو استخدامها كجزء من منصات تجارب أكبر.

blocks.text: The STB21NM60N, commonly marked as B21NM60N, is a high-voltage N-Channel Power MOSFET designed for demanding power switching applications. With a 600V drain-source rating (VDS) and up to 17A drain current (ID), it’s well-suited for high-power SMPS stages, PFC circuits, inverter sections, motor drives, and other high-voltage conversion designs that require strong current handling.

Built in a D2PAK (surface-mount) package, this MOSFET supports efficient thermal transfer to the PCB copper area, enabling robust power dissipation when properly laid out. It offers up to 140W maximum power dissipation under suitable thermal conditions and is rated for a maximum junction temperature of 150°C, making it reliable for heavy-duty operation.

For switching behavior, the device provides a fast rise time of up to 15ns, supporting high-efficiency switching topologies when paired with an appropriate gate driver. The total gate charge (Qg) is 66nC, which should be considered when selecting the gate driver strength and switching frequency. The output capacitance (Coss) is 110pF, impacting switching losses and EMI performance in high-voltage designs.

In conduction mode, the MOSFET features a low maximum RDS(on) of 0.22Ω, helping reduce conduction losses compared with many standard 600V MOSFETs—especially useful in higher-current paths. The gate threshold voltage (VGS(th)) is up to 4V, and the device supports up to ±25V gate-source voltage (VGS).
موسفت قدرة قناة إن 600 فولت 17 أمبير عبوة دي تو باك (STB21NM60N / B21NM60N)

إس تي بي 21 إن إم 60 إن (STB21NM60N) والموسوم غالبًا بكود B21NM60N هو موسفت قدرة بقناة إن عالي الجهد مخصص لتطبيقات التبديل الشاقة في إلكترونيات القدرة. يتحمل جهدًا حتى 600 فولت بين المصرف والمصدر، ويصل تيار المصرف إلى 17 أمبير، ما يجعله مناسبًا لمراحل القدرة في مزودات الطاقة التبديلية عالية القدرة، ودوائر تصحيح معامل القدرة، وأقسام العواكس، وبعض تطبيقات قيادة المحركات والتحويل عالي الجهد.

يأتي هذا الموسفت في عبوة دي تو باك المناسبة للتركيب السطحي، وتُساعد على نقل الحرارة بكفاءة إلى مساحة النحاس في اللوحة عند التصميم الحراري الجيد. يدعم قدرة تبديد قصوى 140 وات وفق ظروف التبريد والتصميم المناسبة، مع أقصى حرارة للوصلة 150 درجة مئوية لثبات أفضل في التشغيل المستمر.

من ناحية التبديل، يتميز بزمن صعود سريع يصل إلى 15 نانوثانية كحد أقصى لرفع الكفاءة وتقليل الفقد عند استخدام دائرة قيادة بوابة مناسبة. وتبلغ شحنة البوابة الكلية 66 نانوكولوم، لذلك يجب مراعاتها عند اختيار درايفر البوابة وتردد التبديل. كما أن سعة الخرج 110 بيكوفاراد تؤثر على الفقد أثناء التبديل والتداخل الكهرومغناطيسي في الدوائر عالية الجهد.

وفي حالة التوصيل، يقدم الموسفت مقاومة توصيل منخفضة حتى 0.22 أوم كحد أقصى لتقليل فقد القدرة أثناء مرور التيار، وهو ما يكون مهمًا جدًا في مسارات التيار الأعلى. كما أن جهد عتبة البوابة يصل إلى 4 فولت كحد أقصى، ويتحمل جهدًا بين البوابة والمصدر حتى 25 فولت.

blocks.text: WAGO F15 Wire Connector 1 In 5 Out – Compact Spring Lever Distribution Connector
WAGO NV-F15 Wire Connector 1 In 5 Out

The WAGO NV-F15 Wire Connector is a practical and space-saving solution for electrical installations that require one input line to be distributed into multiple output lines safely and neatly. With its 1 input and 5 output configuration, this connector is especially useful for parallel wiring, branch distribution, and organized cable routing in compact wiring environments.

This WAGO wire connector uses a spring lever clamping mechanism, allowing wires to be inserted and locked quickly without twisting, soldering, or using screw terminals. This makes installation faster, reduces wiring effort, and makes future maintenance or rewiring easier. Each wire is held individually, helping provide stable contact and secure conductor retention.

The WAGO NV-F15 is suitable for solid, stranded, and flexible conductors, making it practical for lighting circuits, distribution points, junction boxes, switchboards, control systems, low-voltage installations, and general electrical projects. Its compact body helps save space while keeping the wiring layout clean and organized.

The housing is made from insulating PA material, offering good durability for practical use. The connector is designed for reliable low-voltage electrical performance and convenient repeated use when wiring changes are needed. It is commonly available in different handle colors such as orange or blue, depending on stock and batch.

If you need a compact distribution connector that combines quick lever operation, reusable design, secure wire grip, and simple 1-to-5 branching, the WAGO NV-F15 is a practical choice for many electrical wiring applications.

يُعد موصل الأسلاك WAGO NV-F15 من الحلول العملية جدًا في أعمال توزيع وتفريع الكهرباء داخل المساحات الصغيرة والتركيبات التي تحتاج إلى تنظيم جيد للتوصيلات. يأتي هذا الموديل بتصميم دخل واحد وخمسة مخارج، لذلك فهو مناسب جدًا لتوزيع خط كهربائي واحد إلى عدة خطوط خروج بشكل مرتب وآمن داخل الدوائر الكهربائية المختلفة.

يعتمد هذا موصل WAGO على آلية تثبيت برافعة زنبركية، وهي طريقة سهلة وسريعة في تركيب الأسلاك مقارنة بطرق التوصيل التقليدية. يتم رفع الرافعة، ثم إدخال السلك بعد تجريده، ثم غلق الرافعة للحصول على تثبيت محكم واتصال كهربائي ثابت، بدون الحاجة إلى لف الأسلاك أو لحامها أو استخدام مسامير ربط. وهذا يسهّل التركيب، ويقلل وقت العمل، ويجعل أعمال الصيانة أو إعادة التوصيل أكثر راحة.

يدعم WAGO NV-F15 أنواعًا متعددة من الأسلاك، بما في ذلك الأسلاك الصلبة والمجدولة والمرنة، مما يجعله مناسبًا لتطبيقات كثيرة مثل دوائر الإضاءة، وصناديق التوصيل، ونقاط التوزيع، ولوحات التحكم، والمشاريع المنزلية، والتوصيلات الكهربائية منخفضة الجهد. كما أن حجمه المدمج يساعد على توفير مساحة مع الحفاظ على شكل مرتب ومنظم للأسلاك.

جسم الموصل مصنوع من خامة عازلة من مادة بي ايه، وهي مناسبة للاستخدام العملي في أعمال التوصيل الكهربائي. كما يتوفر هذا الموديل غالبًا بألوان مختلفة لمقابض الرافعة مثل البرتقالي أو الأزرق حسب المتاح في المخزون أو دفعة الإنتاج، مع ثبات نفس الوظيفة الأساسية والمواصفات العامة.

إذا كنت تحتاج إلى موصل أسلاك WAGO عملي لتوزيع خط واحد إلى خمسة مخارج بشكل سريع وآمن ومنظم، فإن WAGO NV-F15 يقدم لك حلًا مناسبًا يجمع بين سهولة الاستخدام، وثبات التوصيل، وإمكانية إعادة الاستخدام، والحجم العملي.

blocks.text: OSEPP Female Headers 40 Pin 10 PCS OP-LS-00006

The OSEPP Female Headers 40 Pin 10 PCS set is a practical and essential connector solution for electronics prototyping, development boards, Arduino projects, microcontroller interfacing, and custom PCB applications. Each strip is designed as a single-row female header with 40 holes and a standard 0.1 inch pitch, making it compatible with a wide range of male pin headers, development boards, and common electronics modules.

This OSEPP Female Headers 40 Pin 10 PCS pack is especially useful for makers, students, technicians, and engineers who need reliable socket-style connections in breadboard-compatible or PCB-based projects. Because each strip can be cut to the required length using standard wire cutters, it provides excellent flexibility for custom circuits, shield headers, adapter boards, sensor interfaces, and embedded development work.

The standard spacing of the OSEPP Female Headers 40 Pin 10 PCS makes these headers suitable for many common applications in digital and embedded electronics. They can be used to create removable board connections, interface expansion rows, replace worn sockets, or build neat and serviceable connections between modules and controller boards. Their single-row format also makes them convenient for organized routing and compact board design.

This product is a useful choice for development work where modularity, serviceability, and quick assembly are important. Whether you are assembling a DIY electronics project, preparing a custom interface board, expanding a development platform, or stocking workshop essentials, the OSEPP Female Headers 40 Pin 10 PCS set offers a simple and reliable connection option.

blocks.text: Linear Slide Pot 100k 104 — 3-Pin, Short-Throw, Mechanical End-Detent

The Linear Slide Pot 100k 104 is a single-gang 100 kΩ linear slide potentiometer (code 104) with 3 pins. Your unit measurements are used as the definitive specs: body 45 mm length × 8.2 mm width, slider shaft 14.7 mm length, and a travel (stroke) of 35 mm. One end of the travel has a mechanical detent (click) region; with only 3 pins, this detent is tactile only and does not actuate an electrical switch.
✅ 100 kΩ linear (104): Predictable position-to-voltage behavior for compact mixers and controllers.
🔌 3-pin simplicity: Use as a voltage divider (3 pins) or a variable resistor (2 pins).
📏 Short-throw form factor: 35 mm travel within a 45 × 8.2 mm body—fast, space-efficient control.
🧲 Mechanical end-detent: Clear tactile feedback at one end of the stroke; no extra terminals involved.
🧩 Small slider shaft: 14.7 mm shaft length for low-profile panels and compact caps.
🎚️ Compact audio: Channel trim, send level, cue balance, FX depth.
🎛️ Synth/MIDI DIY: Filter amount, modulation depth, morph controls.
🔆 Control/education: Brightness blend, general CV input, ADC demos.
⚙️ Voltage divider: Outer pins to reference (e.g., 0–5 V), wiper (center pin) as the control voltage to your circuit or ADC.
🧪 Rheostat mode: Wiper plus either outer pin if you need variable resistance only.
🎚️ Detent behavior: The end-click is mechanical; resistance continues changing to the hard stop—no on/off switch present.
🛠️ Panel/slot alignment: Center the slot over the 35 mm travel; keep the carriage parallel to avoid rub and wear.
🧼 Care: Keep dust/flux off the track; avoid solvents on the carbon element; adjust with light force.

blocks.v: Mechanical end-detent at one end (no switch)

blocks.text: ✅ 1× Linear Slide Pot 100k 104, 3-pin, 45 × 8.2 mm body, 14.7 mm shaft, 35 mm travel, mechanical end-detent.
Is the click an on/off switch? No. It’s a mechanical detent only; there are no additional electrical terminals.
Is the taper logarithmic? No. It’s linear (code 104).
Can I read it with an MCU? Yes. Wire as a divider and read the wiper with an ADC.
Can it drive a load directly? No. Use it as a control element, not a power path.
Common terms: linear slide pot 100k, 104 slide potentiometer, 3-pin slider, short-throw fader, mechanical detent slide pot.

blocks.text: Mechanic DS6 Solder Wire 0.4mm 40g (Sn60/Pb40, Rosin Core)

Mechanic DS6 Solder Wire 0.4mm 40g is engineered for makers, repair pros, and training labs that demand predictable flow, bright joints, and clean boards. This leaded alloy with a rosin core blends high wettability with thermal stability, so you can land a shiny fillet on the first pass instead of reworking the same pad twice. Whether you’re dragging across a row of SMD pins or feeding precisely into a through‑hole, the slim filament keeps control in your fingertips. The label highlights a flux content between 1.0–3.0%, traces of chloride under 0.05% in the flux, and messaging about low smoke, low splash, and no‑residue behavior, which lines up with the day‑to‑day reality of tidy, reliable electronics soldering.
✅ Fine‑pitch control — The 0.4 mm diameter feeds like pencil lead, letting you dose a pad without flooding nearby pads or jumpers.
🔥 Consistent wetting — The Sn60/Pb40 alloy has a forgiving melting window and a stable surface tension, so it pulls into a curved, concave fillet that looks right and conducts reliably.
🧪 Rosin core built in — The active rosin formulation inside the wire breaks oxides quickly and keeps the melt pool tidy with minimal spatter, giving you faster joints under normal bench temperatures.
🧼 Clean finish — Residual flux wipes easily with isopropyl alcohol; many boards look presentable right off the iron, especially when heat is controlled and the tip is properly tinned.
🧯 Thermal headroom — DS6 handles the typical 320–360 °C tip range well, letting you work across thin sensor pads and heavier ground pours with only modest temperature tweaks.
🛠️ Everyday reliability — A 40 g spool balances compact size with meaningful capacity for classrooms, field kits, and small production runs.
🎯 Repeatable results — Flux percentage printed on the label means predictable activity from spool to spool when you’re training new hands or building process sheets.
What you can build with Mechanic DS6 Solder Wire 0.4mm 40g
✅ SMD rework that looks factory — Drag solder SOICs, clean bridges with wick, and leave a row of pins bright and even.
✅ Sensor and module wiring — Land thin enamel wire on tiny pads without drowning test points; the 0.4 mm feed helps you control the puddle.
✅ Connector touch‑ups — Reinforce headers, jumpers, and switch tabs in consumer electronics; low splash keeps housings clean.
✅ Education and training — Students see instant wetting feedback and learn to read the concave fillet, not just the shine.
✅ Field repairs — The 40 g spool drops in a pouch; rosin core means fewer bottles on the bench when you’re traveling light.
✅ Prep the tip — Wipe on brass wool or a damp sponge and re‑tin immediately; a bright tip transfers heat, wets faster, and protects pads from prolonged heating.
✅ Aim for a concave fillet — Feed only until the solder forms a curved meniscus that hugs the pad and lead; if you see a ball, you fed too much.
✅ Stabilize small parts — Use tweezers, tape, or a dab of solder paste to hold tiny components; then feed DS6 to finish the joint in a single, confident move.
✅ Mind the copper mass — Bump tip temperature a little when you hit ground planes; drop back for delicate pads so the flux doesn’t over‑cook.
✅ Finish clean — If you need pristine boards, a quick IPA wipe removes rosin traces and leaves that crisp, professional look.

blocks.v: High wettability, thermal stability, low smoke, low splash

blocks.text: ✅ Irons — Temperature‑controlled stations with fine tips excel; conical or hoof tips let you choose between point dosing and drag soldering.
✅ Flux — The rosin core is enough for most work; for stubborn pads add a touch of no‑clean or RMA gel and let DS6 carry the rest.
✅ Wick — Pair with fine copper braid to lift bridges; DS6 replenishes pins after cleanup without over‑feeding.
✅ Magnification — A small visor makes 0.4 mm shine by reducing hand overshoot and improving angle control.
✅ Cleaning — Keep IPA and lint‑free swabs nearby; a single swipe returns the board to a professional finish.
🧯 Lead warning — Contains lead; wash hands after use and keep food and drinks off the bench.
🧤 Ventilation — Use fume extraction or at least a fan; even low‑smoke rosin benefits from airflow.
🧪 Storage — Keep the spool bagged away from dust; store cool and dry so the flux core stays active.
🧰 ESD awareness — When working on sensitive modules, bond your wrist to ground; DS6 won’t save a zapped gate.

✅ Is Mechanic DS6 Solder Wire 0.4mm 40g good for drag soldering? Yes—pair a hoof tip, wet the tip with a small bead, and slide along the pins. The rosin core refreshes the bead as you go; follow with a light wick pass if needed.
✅ Do I need extra flux? The rosin core is sufficient most of the time. For oxidized pads or heavy copper, a tiny dab of no‑clean gel accelerates the wetting and reduces dwell time.
✅ What temperature should I pick? Start around 340 °C and adjust for the board’s thermal mass. The right temperature is the lowest that completes the joint in two to three seconds.
✅ Will it leave residue? Rosin leaves a light film that often looks fine; if you want perfectly clean boards, wipe with isopropyl alcohol.
✅ Can I use DS6 on battery tabs or large chassis? Those require higher heat and different alloys. DS6 excels on electronics pads; for heavy tabs, use a wider tip and consider specialty solders.

الفصل الاول: بيتكلم عن الأساسيات الي هتحتاجها علشان تعرف تتعامل مع الاردوينو بأسلوب سليم و يبقي معاك اساسيات

الفصل الثاني: بيتكلم عن كل حاجة ليها علاقة بالاردوينو مثل انواع الاردوينو، يعني ايه متحكم دقيق، بعض المصطلحات زي مثل الاشارات الرقمية و التماثلية و يعني ايه مداخل و مخارج. ازاي تدخل كهرباء الاردوينو و المنافذ المميزه الاردوينو. الجزء الثاني بيتكلم عن تجهيزات البرنامج و تعريف لوحة الاردوينو علي الجهاز
الفصل الثالث بيتكلم عن البرمجة و شامل مواضيع كثير عن برمجة الاردوينو و امثله كتير جدا علشان تقدر تفهم و تستوعب
الفصل الرابع بيتكلم عن اكتر ١٠ حساسات موجودين في المشاريع و السوق. ازاي بيشتغل من جوه، ازاي اكتب كود علشان اخد منه إشارات، ايه استخدامه و بيعمل ايه.
الفصل الخامس بيتكلم عن ثلاث مواتير أساسية في عمل اي روبت أو جهاز (دي سي، سيرفو، ستيبر) و انواع الاستيبر و الdrivers بتعهم (l298d, l293, A4988) ده غير طبعا اهم حاجة و هي الريلي مديول
الفصل السادس بيتكلم عن التحكم و الشاشات: التحكم زي ال joystick و ال keypad. المقصود من الشاشات هو أن كل حاجة تقدر من خلالها تتطلع إشارة زي RGB, LCD, 7 segment, buzzer
و اخر و اهم حاجة في الفصل ده shift register (من اكتر الحاجات الي هتخليك توفر O/I من الاردوينو)

The refillable pH composite electrode has a dosing hole on the electrode shell. When the external reference solution of the electrode is lost, the dosing hole can be opened to replenish the KCl solution. The non refillable pH composite electrode is equipped with gel-like KCl, which is not easy to lose and has no liquid filling hole.

The characteristic of the rechargeable pH composite electrode is that the reference solution has a higher permeation rate, the liquid junction potential is stable and reproducible, and the measurement accuracy is higher. And when the reference electrode is reduced or contaminated, the KCl solution can be supplemented or replaced, but the disadvantage is that it is more troublesome to use. When using the refillable pH composite electrode, the filling hole should be opened to increase the liquid pressure and accelerate the electrode response. When the liquid level of the dielectric fluid is lower than the filling hole 2cm, new dielectric fluid should be added in time.

The non-rechargeable pH composite electrode is characterized by simple maintenance and convenient use, so it has also been widely used. However, when used as a laboratory pH electrode, under long-term and continuous use conditions, the KCl concentration at the liquid junction will decrease, which will affect the accuracy of the test. Therefore, when the non-rechargeable pH composite electrode is not in use, it should be immersed in the electrode soaking solution, so that the electrode performance will be very good in the next test. However, most laboratory pH electrodes are not long-term and continuous tests, so this structure is not The impact of accuracy is relatively small.
